lines: News of the young man in the fire reached the king.
He was a man so proud of his kingdom that he argued with Ibrahim about his Lord.
Ibrahim said: my Lord is the One who gives life and causes death.
The king said: I give life and cause death. I can pardon a man, or have him killed.
So Ibrahim said: "Indeed, Allah brings up the sun from the east, so bring it up from the west."
And the disbeliever was left speechless. A king, with all his armies... silenced by one sentence.
